launch.playback: Play once on a cold or warm start. End as soon as the app is ready; do not wait for the animation.
launch.description: The base enters, pillars rise left to right, then the roof locks into place.

loading.playback: Use only while work is pending. Stop when complete and while the view is hidden or the app is in the background. This is not percentage progress.
loading.description: Each pillar compresses, lifts, rocks and settles in a travelling wave. The roof and base remain fixed.
loading.motionModel: Anticipation, parabolic flight and damped landing

android.themeSelection: values and values-night choose light and dark colours automatically.
android.artwork: Same mark and gradient stops; SVG contact blur is omitted because VectorDrawable does not support blur filters.
android.integration: Copy res into the app module. Assign the launch AVD and background to the splash theme. Use the platform SplashScreen API on Android 12+ or AndroidX core-splashscreen. Load the static ic_ecourts drawable when animations are disabled. Reuse each loading drawable instance only for one visible view and stop it when the view leaves the screen.

accessibility.svg: Animations run only when prefers-reduced-motion is no-preference. The fallback is the complete static mark.
accessibility.android: Check the system animation setting before starting in-app animations. When animations are disabled, or the app requests reduced motion, display ic_ecourts or ic_ecourts_mono without starting an animator.
accessibility.mono: White foreground on transparency. Tint natively or place on a contrasting dark surface.
accessibility.loadingLabel: Supply a localised loading label in the host UI.
